dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Diona? What are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: It's my first time seeing these little guys. They're from Natlan, right? Hehe, they're so cute.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Alice put a version of the Cat's Tail here and asked me to run it. It has the set up I'm used to and everything. Now, all I need to do is make some drinks.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: And you know what? This is the perfect chance to change all the ingredients to super weird stuff. Haha, I'll get people to lose interest for sure!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like your campaign is going strong, huh. Even out here...

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Of course. The only thing missing is... the cats, actually. They seem to prefer the real Cat's Tail.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: But, that's not a huge surprise. Cats are sensitive about where they live. Even if the place looks exactly the same, they'll know something's off.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: So Alice said she would find different staff instead. And then these little saurians appeared.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Bennett gave me a few pointers on how to get along with them... Turns out, there's not a huge difference between them and a cat or dog.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, then you should call this place "The Saurian's Tail" instead!
